description: Failure messages of the four number comparisons, toBeCloseTo (default and given precision), toBeNaN and bigint operands, with their .not voices and the matcher errors for a non-number received. Each test makes one failing assertion. Vitest prints toBeCloseTo's expected difference as `10 ** -precision / 2` computes it, which V8 changed between Node majors (0.0000049999999999999996 on 22, 0.000005 on 24 and 26 for precision 5), so Vitest's golden is checked on Node 24 and 26.
